app.name: CO2 Ring
app.summary: CO2 concentration with a colour ring and a large ppm value.
app.sensor_hint: Choose a sensor, air quality entity or number entity.
app.thresholds_hint: Two ppm values separated by a semicolon: lower;upper, for example 800;1200.
app.ring_range_hint: Two ppm values separated by a semicolon: minimum;maximum, for example 400;2000.
app.high_color: Colour at or above upper threshold
app.ring_scale_hint: Make the gauge smaller than its largest fitting size.
app.value_layout_hint: X;Y;size, for example 0;15;180. Size is a percentage (up to 300); X/Y shift the number from its centred position, relative to tile size.
app.co2_layout_hint: X;Y;size, for example 0;0;100. CO2 starts at the upper left, outside the ring.
app.unit_layout_hint: X;Y;size, for example 0;0;100. X/Y shift ppm from its default position below the number, as a percent of tile size.
